invariants.rationale: clusteringGroup is dereferenced in clusteringGroup.getSlices(), so it must be non-null at method entry.
instantTime is passed to getRecordIterator and may be used in further operations, so it should not be null.
Typically, a clustering group should have at least one slice to make reading records meaningful.
The method maps each slice to a clustering operation, so all slices should be non-null.
Clustering instantTime is usually a non-empty string representing the operation's logical time.
